scope: bounded pack JSON source search, exact navigation and reviewed buffer replacements
checks: literal regex metacharacters/non-overlap, Unicode case-fold offsets, exact line/column/source spans, CRLF-to-textarea selection mapping and bounded/cancelled/incomplete captures
selected source splices preserve BOM/CRLF/exact number and unknown tokens, treat $ replacement text literally, repair syntax and refuse duplicate/schema/stale/overlapping changes
controlled pack search includes actual unsaved source and invalid JSON, exact match navigation and pending capture cancellation
reviewed selected/cross-page replacement updates only the live buffer once in undo history; changed review text and stale ownership refuse without saving
actual application source navigation rejects stale disk/open text, and modal/native-field shortcuts cannot undo hidden workspace edits; implicit browsing-dialog submit stays open
limits: Three tiny authored sources, one 33-match UI boundary, pure modules and controlled Node DOM/application hosts. Literal source search is not semantic/native reference validation; JSON escapes are searched as written. Match/capture budgets and incomplete diagnostics are explicit; current-buffer replacement requires a complete capture and bounded valid JSON/schema result. Browser layout/focus/native selection/keyboard/storage/network interleaving and native/client/release verification remain pending. No native build/generation, registry/state sweep, GPU work, broad suite or GitHub workflow.
